chunks: Pray the prayer at its appointed time, and do not hasten its time for the sake of leisure, nor delay it from its time due to preoccupation, and know that every act of yours is dependent on your prayer.
ai.seo_question: How should one balance prayer with daily work and leisure according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this directive to Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) establishes the precise timing of Salah as the cornerstone of administrative and spiritual discipline, warning against letting worldly busyness or leisure dictate worship. This hadith underscores the Shia scholarly view that Salah is the 'pillar of religion,' serving as the metric by which the validity of all subsequent deeds is measured. It highlights the integration of ritual purity with governance, where punctuality in prayer reflects integrity in leadership.
